note: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 iteration count for the wfminv-jwt-v1 on-disk/export format. Shared by companion/wfm-core/src/auth.rs (JWT_KDF_ITERATIONS) and prototype/src/lib/crypto.ts (KDF_ITERATIONS) - a mismatch means the companion encrypts at one count and the browser decrypts at another, surfacing as a false 'wrong passphrase' error.
